title: Three Pipes, Three Lanes (Deploy Doctrine)
style: uptempo dub-influenced instructional hip-hop hybrid, 100 BPM, deep dub bass with delay throws on the offbeat, fingerpicked acoustic guitar with spring reverb, brushed drums with rim-shot accents, hammond organ stabs on the hooks, warm confident male english lead vocal half-rapped half-sung teacher-cadence, soft female ad-libs on the hook, occasional dub siren and tape echo on key lines, late-night ops-room feel, 336 hz subharmonic pad carrier, vinyl warmth, deliberate diction so the ops details land clean
lyrics:
[Intro — spoken, ops-cadence]
Three pipes. Three lanes. One operator. One helmsman. This is the deploy doctrine.

[Verse 1 — the three pipes]
Pipe A on the Mac, rsync to VDS three-three-six on the wire
Repointed to Contabo, wave one and one-point-five landed in the fire
Pipe B on the rclone, Drive to VDS, wave one manifest ready to push
Thirty-one verified IDs, script in the brush, waiting on the Contabo probe
Pipe C on the VDS, gh repo clone coreintentdev slash coreintent on the box
Three pipes, three paths, one destination, no dropped locks

[Pre-chorus]
One pipe down doesn't kill the deploy, that's the redundancy plan
Three paths to the same shore, the captain holds the span
Mac-bypass on B, git-pull on C, rsync on A when the key loads through
Three pipes, three lanes, one operator, one truth

[CHORUS]
Three pipes, three lanes, deploy doctrine on the run
One operator, one helmsman, one ship, one sun
No lane monitors another, sight comes via paste
Cross-lane status from the dump, no context goes to waste
A on the Mac, B on the rclone, C on the VDS clone
Three paths to Contabo, no deploy stands alone
(Backing): Three pipes — three lanes — one operator hold

[Verse 2 — the three lanes visibility]
Thread on the Linux VM, own repo only, no Mac no VDS no Suno seen
Keel on the Mac plus VDS when the SSH key loads through the screen
Lane on Chrome to Suno account one, audio tracks on the slate, no repo direct
Kōwhai on Chrome to Suno account two, fifteen tracks rendered, no repo connect
Whetū in the local lane, merged catalog index, the cross-lane view
Five lane-names, one operator, the dump-paste is what holds the crew

[CHORUS]
Three pipes, three lanes, deploy doctrine on the run
One operator, one helmsman, one ship, one sun
No lane monitors another, sight comes via paste
Cross-lane status from the dump, no context goes to waste
A on the Mac, B on the rclone, C on the VDS clone
Three paths to Contabo, no deploy stands alone

[Bridge — slower, dub-out, doctrine layer]
VDS sandbox tests first, public second, that's the gate
Doctrine twenty-four filter clean before any Suno generate
Honest sandbox boundary — Linux VM with limited tools
Out-of-the-sandbox framing is incorrect, breaks the teaching rules
No AI-as-protagonist slope — the catalog holds the counter-shape
Resist the slope on every contribution, that's the cape

[Verse 3 — the open decisions]
Five open decisions waiting on the captain's call to land
Pipe B execute against Contabo, script ready in the hand
Notion MCP returns only Linear tickets, connector verification due
NotebookLM source — Apple Notes, Notion, Obsidian, browser-only — which one's true
Update PR sixty-seven title and body to reflect the current scope
Music-as-backup recovery pipeline brief from Keel — yes, no, or later, we cope

[CHORUS final — anthemic, both voices, dub throws]
Three pipes, three lanes, deploy doctrine on the run
One operator, one helmsman, one ship, one sun
A, B, C — Mac, rclone, git-clone
Three paths, one shore, no deploy stands alone
No lane sees the whole — paste is the wire
Cross-lane status from the dump, that's the fire

[Outro — dub-spare, then spoken]
Three pipes hold. Three lanes hold. The dump-paste holds the view.
A, B, C. Mac, rclone, git-clone. One operator. One helmsman.
Three-three-six. Even slate.
